question.question_text: Identify the technology the camera wearer used to maintain cleanliness in the workshop.

answer_options.text: The camera wearer used a vacuum machine connected to cutting equipment, a dust collector, and manual sweeping to maintain cleanliness in the workshop.
The camera wearer used a vacuum machine connected to sawing equipment and a dust collector to maintain cleanliness in the workshop.
The camera wearer used a vacuum machine connected to sawing equipment, a dust collector, and an electrostatic air cleaner to maintain cleanliness in the workshop.
The camera wearer used a blower machine connected to drilling equipment and a debris collector to maintain cleanliness in the workshop.
The camera wearer used a vacuum machine connected to sawing equipment to maintain cleanliness in the workshop.

shared_investigation.established_facts: The camera wearer used a vacuum cleaner to clean the floor, as observed in multiple frames (V02, V03, V04, V05, V06, V07, V08, V09, V10, V11, V12, V13, V14, V15). No dust collector or electrostatic air cleaner was visible in any of these observations.
